_comments: IT SHIPS DISABLED AND SET TO PREVIEW, the same two-step gate as the renewal job:
· Status Disabled keeps a lower environment from cutting customers off the moment this lands.
· Preview true means an enabled job reports what it would suspend and writes nothing.
Enable it, read the run's Changes output, then set Preview to false.
03:30 UTC, after the 03:00 renewal pass, so a renewal placed tonight is seen with its own grants.
Daily because days past due change daily. ConcurrencyMode Skip, MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: the pass
is idempotent, so a catch-up is one run, not one per missed day. RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun false:
a first deployment must not suspend anybody before somebody has read the preview.
OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID are unset: they name people, which differ per environment.

fields.Name: Orders — Enforce Payment-Gated Access (daily)
fields.Description: Suspends OnFirstPayment grants on renewal orders past the RenewalAccessCutoffDaysPastDue setting, and restores payment-suspended grants whose payment has arrived. Ships disabled and set to Preview: enable it, confirm the Changes list on the run, then set Preview to false.
